top_choice_rationale: Buchwald and Hartwig have a mechanistically distinct, mature and cleanly attributed achievement: ligand design solved the slow C-N reductive elimination versus beta-hydride elimination problem, with an amine-deprotonation step that has no counterpart in the C-C couplings honoured in 2010. Three decades of independent validation and routine pharmaceutical use support it. Sequencing by synthesis (P002) is real chemistry but has crowded credit; P003 pairs Liu alone with an unrelated theory topic; P004 omits documented lipid contributors.
